_README: Genuine-floor provenance (Sprint 38 P6c). JSON, not YAML, deliberately:
PyYAML is not a declared dependency, and a tracker that dies on CI for a
missing import is a gate that does not gate.
The genuine floor is NOT derivable from the results DB. A mechanical
`Match - (presolve AND match)` count over the convex candidates yields 65
and looks authoritative, because the qualifier that actually defines the
floor -- 'the cold emit is byte-identical to pre-fix, so the match is a
methodology artifact rather than a genuine one' -- lives only in a
hand-maintained partition. Three independent derivations of the historical
figure give three different answers (65, 93, 76): the floor cannot be
RECONSTRUCTED.
It can be ACCUMULATED. This file declares an opaque baseline and appends
one auditable entry per movement:   floor = baseline.count + len(entries).
The baseline is never re-litigated.
DEFINITION AMENDED, Sprint 40 P1 (owner Decision 1 = B, OWNER_DECISION_BRIEF.md,
answered 2026-10-14 at b44344a2): a GENUINE floor movement is a match a real
emit fix produced. A LICENSE-UNLOCKED cold match -- a model whose cold emit was
never changed, and only became runnable once the full license replaced the
demo -- is NOT genuine and NOT counted. It is recorded in `license_unlocked`,
a separate, NON-COUNTING ledger, and reported beside the floor:
'floor 75 (+k license-unlocked, not counted)'.
* The ledger takes COLD matches only. A presolve-only (warm-start) match of an
unlocked model stays under the EXISTING rule: methodology, not counted, and
NOT in this ledger, unless an emit fix changed its cold emit.
* Fail-before sub-rule: a model whose emit was fixed in an earlier sprint but
could never run is credited as fix-driven genuine (an `entries` item) ONLY if
its pre-fix golden, run under the license, does NOT match. Otherwise it is
license-unlocked like the rest.
* A model may not appear in both `entries` and `license_unlocked`.

baseline.note: In-corpus only. The historical figure 76 credited three non_convex, OUT-OF-CORPUS models (ps2_f_s, ps2_s, ps3_s_gic) from the Sprint-31 +4; 76 - 3 = 73. The S31-S37 series was therefore overstated by 3, and Sprint 37's advance re-reads as 72 -> 73. Per-model records for the opaque 'S28 genuine 68' block were never kept and are NOT reconstructible -- only 14 of the 76 were ever attributable by name. Option (a) (in-corpus) was chosen over (b) (keep 76 with a documented scope) because the floor is reported in the same breath as Solve and Match, which are strictly in-corpus; a metric whose corpus differs silently from its neighbours is the more dangerous of the two states.

_entry_schema.limb: which partition it moved INTO (e.g. cold-match), so a later reader can tell a genuine cold match from a methodology one without re-deriving it
_entry_schema.since_sprint: sprint number in which it landed

_license_unlocked_schema.limb: must be 'license-unlocked-cold-match' (cold matches only; presolve-only matches never enter)
_license_unlocked_schema.since_sprint: sprint in which the licensed run measured it
_license_unlocked_schema.evidence: the licensed run, in one line, with its batch commit
